blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) ensured public safety and assistance to commuters who may be affected by the transport strike from Monday to Wednesday. NCRPO Officer-in-Charge Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano directed all police districts and stations to coordinate with concerned local government units, transport authorities, and other partner agencies to ensure that security and public assistance measures are in place, particularly in areas expected to experience high passenger volumes and transportation disruptions. “Our police presence will be visible in strategic areas throughout Metro Manila.
